name: bootloader-worker
description: Unified Cloudflare Worker for bootloader.art - thumbnails, sandbox sessions, IPFS proxy, and frontend

scripts.build:frontend:mainnet: cd ../apps/web && VITE_MEDIA_CDN_URL=https://media.bootloader.art npm run build && rm -rf ../../worker/public && cp -r dist ../../worker/public
scripts.build:frontend:ghostnet: cd ../apps/web && VITE_MEDIA_CDN_URL=https://media.bootloader.art npm run build:ghostnet && rm -rf ../../worker/public && cp -r dist ../../worker/public
scripts.deploy:beta: npm run build:frontend:ghostnet && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:thumbnails: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && wrangler deploy --env production
